---
title: "Semantics registry"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

The registry lists SAS behaviours that commonly differ from base R defaults
and records whether sasonr reproduces them. The status comes from the
offline conformance cases (gold standard: SAS 9.4).

* **verified**: all linked cases match SAS.
* **partial**: some cases match; the unverified situations stop with
  `sasonr_unsupported`.
* **unsupported**: not implemented yet; using it stops the program.

```{r}
reg <- utils::read.csv(system.file("registry", "semantics.csv", package = "sasonr"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character")
cat(sprintf("Entries: %d (verified %d, partial %d, unsupported %d, not applicable %d)",
            nrow(reg), sum(reg$sasonr_status == "verified"),
            sum(reg$sasonr_status == "partial"),
            sum(reg$sasonr_status == "unsupported"),
            sum(reg$sasonr_status %in% c("n/a", "not_applicable", "na"))))
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(reg[, c("entry", "kind", "sas_behaviour", "r_default", "sasonr_status", "cases", "cases_pass")],
             col.names = c("Entry", "Kind", "SAS behaviour", "R default", "sasonr", "Cases", "Pass"))
```

The list of entries is based on the semantics registry of the
[sas2r](https://cran.r-project.org/package=sas2r) package (Apache License
2.0); descriptions and statuses are maintained by sasonr.
